referencePurpose: Authored developmental regression only. These are proposed labels generated by an AI assistant before model generation, not physician gold, clinical consensus, independent held-out validation, or observed outcomes.
severityDefinition: Proposed potential harm from inappropriate self-care or delayed assessment, not actual injury or an established diagnosis. Labels require independent clinical review.
timingDefinition: Proposed assessment urgency for future review; not a separate target emitted by the three-bucket model or a service-level promise.
